description: Defines the DocModel class for handling documentation strings related to AWS service versions, operations, errors, and shapes, including methods for retrieving and cleaning documentation content.

classes.name: DocModel
classes.description: A class that encapsulates documentation strings for AWS service versions and provides methods to extract specific documentation parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DocModel with documentation data, requiring the 'tidy' PHP extension.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the documentation model to an array.

methods.name: getOperationDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation about a specific operation.

methods.name: getErrorDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation about a specific error.

methods.name: getShapeDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation about a shape, specific to the context, with logic to handle references, base, append, and exclude conditions.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans and formats documentation content using the 'tidy' extension.
